comments.body:
Comes from new recipe that appears after you report Lighthouse of Alexandria (need to reach the deepest part of Sea of Wonders) from Ibn in Alexandria.

Recipe Name : Casting Hyper Rolled Steel Plating
Skill Reqs : Casting Rank 15
Ingredients : Hyper Steel Plating + 2x Improved Steel Sheet + 3x Strange Armouring

Stats : 80/80 Durability, +17 Armour, -16 Speed.
